requirements.description: Authenticated demo roles and server-enforced role boundaries
Distinct navigation for Ballots, Vote, Turnout, Results, Audit
Same-origin Node/Express server, SQLite persistence, health route, and offline browser runtime
As Coordinator, create a ballot with at least two choices and open it. Confirm the eligible membership is captured for that ballot and invalid drafts cannot open.
As one eligible Member, submit a vote. Confirm participation changes, a second vote is refused, and no post-vote view or observed response links the Member to the selected choice.
As Coordinator, close the ballot after voting and confirm further votes are refused while choice totals remain hidden. Publish results and confirm the tally then becomes visible.
Confirm the Observer remains read-only and administrative lifecycle actions appear in the audit without exposing a Member's selected choice.
Accepted mutations survive reload and reauthentication without duplication
Responsive, accessible, legible interface with clear interaction feedback
